note: The baseline: the app0 slot of the device dumps of 2026-09-06, and the version every address in docs/stock-firmware.md and docs/xic.md was found in. The device itself took an OTA to 7.5.4 on 2026-09-07; 7.2.4 stays the reference the emulator work was done on.

dev_stub.evidence: The developer-mode predicate is a compile-time stub (entry a1,32 / movi.n a2,0 / retw.n) at app VA 0x4233abe0, segment 2 (IROM, load 0x42000020 at file 0x1b0020); nothing in 7.2.4 makes it return anything else, so the light panel never shows Memory / Developer / Screen Capture (docs/xic.md, 'How developer mode is enabled').

developer-menu.description: developer mode: Memory / Developer / Screen Capture in the light panel
developer-menu.detail: movi.n a2,0 -> movi.n a2,1 in the developer-mode predicate stub (byte +4)
developer-menu.docs: docs/xic.md; the same bytes as tools/stockdev.py
developer-menu.evidence: Same site as dev_stub: the whole 7-byte stub is matched so the 0x12 is never written into another build's instruction stream.

hidden-menu-rows.description: nav menu: unhide the Preload List and Statistics rows (gate A)
hidden-menu-rows.detail: bltui a9,2,+7 -> bltui a9,2,+255: menu slots 1 and 2 stop being skipped
hidden-menu-rows.evidence: The nav-menu builder walks menu slots 0..7 through the predicate at VA 0x42345158, whose bltui a9,2,+7 hides slots 1 and 2; moving the branch target past the return grows the menu to seven rows, both new pages functional.

lua-apps-row.description: nav menu: a sixth row "Lua Apps" that opens the Lua app list (page 0x09)
lua-apps-row.detail: l8ui a8,a2,172 -> movi a8,1 in the nav-menu builder: slot 3 is always appended
lua-apps-row.evidence: FUN_4213d834 skips slot 3 in its loop and appends it only when presenter+172 is non-zero, which nothing ever writes; making the load a constant 1 gives the menu its Lua Apps row into AppsPagePresenter (page 0x09).

counts.evidence: Headed pack in DROM; its blob ends one byte before the label pack's header, so its free tail is 1 byte (docs/stock-firmware.md section 6).

labels.evidence: Headed pack: 234 groups x 4 languages, blob 13,528 bytes at VA 0x3c3f84ae. The blob ends at 0x3c3fb986 and the DROM bitmap directory starts at 0x3c3fb988, so the stock free tail is 2 bytes until `stockstrings.py compact` frees 497.

toasts.evidence: No header: the u16 offsets[688][4] array starts right after the 0xff that ends the XTZB table at 0x3c48fe94, and the blob follows it. Found by walking back from the blob docs/stock-firmware.md names: group 0 = Cancel, group 3 = 'Region set successfully'. The blob ends where the user_config string of the ordinary string table begins, so it cannot grow.
